name: Humacao (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, red and green, the red stripe narrower: the gold for the crown of the cacique Jumacao, the red for the coat of arms and the green for the arrows of the Taínos.
history: Humacao is a city and municipality on the eastern coast of Puerto Rico, named after the Taíno cacique Jumacao. The colours are based on the coat of arms, designed by Roberto Biascochea Lota and adopted by the Municipal Assembly in November 1975.
